facts.reason: ChatGPT Plus is $20/month, but official API pricing is fixed at $8/M input and $40/M output tokens rather than varying by usage tier (usage tiers only govern rate limits).
Google AI Premium was renamed to Google AI Plus ($4.99/mo); the $19.99/mo tier providing Argon access is Google AI Pro.
Access requires Google AI Pro, Google AI Ultra, or Enterprise plans, not AI Premium.
Current official API pricing is $4.00 per million input and $20.00 per million output tokens, not $5/$30.
GPT-5.6 Sol is not offered on the Free ChatGPT tier; it requires a paid subscription.
